feeds.title: Mythcreants Blog » Worldbuilding
feeds.description: Follow us to know more about worldbuilding, how to develop your fiction, mythical characters and more. Mythcreants is an online publication for speculative fiction storytellers. To better understand and tell the stories we love, we analyze popular works, theorize on storytelling craft, and explore the technical aspects of writing and tabletop roleplaying.

feeds.title: Kanka Blog
feeds.description: Explore the blog to know more about the platform, updates and features, tips for worldbuilding, etc. Kanka is a community-driven worldbuilding and tabletop RPG campaign management tool perfect for worldbuilders and game masters alike.

feeds.title: World Anvil Blog » Worldbuilding
feeds.description: We will be using this space to share not only our latest updates and developments with you but we are also going to be sharing some fantastic worldbuilding resources, interviews and tutorials here too. Our goal is to provide you with clear, meaningful, and inspirational articles to help you build your world. We aim to cover worldbuilding from many different angles for every kind of writer out there. World Anvil is an online toolset specifically designed for worldbuilding. It's perfect for authors, writers, game developers and tabletop gamers - it even comes with a Campaign Manager.

feeds.title: The Art of World Building » News
feeds.description: A guide for authors, gamers, and hobbyists. My blogs will help you rock better and write better. The Art of World Building teaches aspiring storytellers, gamers, and hobbyists how to build believable worlds using time-saving advice, templates, and relevant research so you can make informed decisions. You'll learn how much to build for each scenario, when to do it, and how it can be used in your work.

feeds.title: Worldbuilding Magazine Blog
feeds.description: Your source for Worldbuilding articles, writing, & interviews. We are a dedicated group of worldbuilders with a passion for creating. Our writers and editors spend countless hours pouring their expertise into their articles, to study and use as you see fit. The artists on our team want to make your reading experience as in-depth and enhanced as possible; recognizing that many worldbuilders in their own right communicate concepts better through illustration.

feeds.title: wondrous worldbuilding
feeds.description: Read Prompts, discussion, information, asks, ranting, critiquing, and featured writers... all relating to developing fantastic fictional settings!

feeds.title: Elyden Blog
feeds.description: A blog where I talk about my adventures in worldbuilding and all aspects of it in the fictional world of Elyden - expect ramblings, lots of maps, sporadic bursts of talk about getting published that don't last long, and randomness. I'm a writer, worldbuilder and cartographer. When I'm not working on stuff for my own world I'm working on map commissions for other writers.

feeds.title: The Mudworld Blog » World-building
feeds.description: The blog will be about writing and fantasy roleplaying games along with articles on world-building, how to differentiate your world and characters and more. This blog is for gamers, readers, writers and would-be authors like myself. My chosen genre is fantasy, with a preference for the classics: Tolkien, Lieber, Howard, and Moorcock.

feeds.title: Worldbuilding School Blog
feeds.description: The WorldBuilding School is an online resource teaching authors, artists and game designers how to build their own imaginary world. The articles range from step-by-step tutorials to discussions and essays about worldbuilding.

feeds.title: Stephen Escher » Worldbuilding
feeds.description: I have started this website to help build my writing confidence, as I aspire to write a novel for my worldbuilding project. I'm Stephen Escher, and I'm a conlanger and worldbuilder. For the last few years, I have been working on my personal worlding project and have been constructing languages for it. I also love sci-fi and worldbuilding-based fiction.

feeds.title: LegendKeeper Blog
feeds.description: LegendKeeper posts action-oriented worldbuilding articles and free resources. Browse them all here. LegendKeeper is a world-building app for RPG game-masters and writers. If you've ever wanted to make a comprehensive wiki for your tabletop campaign, or a Google-Maps-style atlas for your fantasy novel's world, we made LegendKeeper for you.

feeds.title: Joseph Malik » Worldbuilding
feeds.description: Explore this section to know more about world-building, story building, character development and more. Joseph Malik is the internationally bestselling author of Dragon's Trail and The New Magic. A disabled veteran and former member of the U.S. Special Operations Command, Joseph Malik has also worked as a stuntman, a high-rise window cleaner, and a touring rock musician. He is a member of SFWA, represented by Sarah Hershman at Hershman Rights Management, NY.
